objective: Write exactly 2 outcome-blind lane-A5 proposal JSONs: deterministic derivatives-calendar structure (quarterly futures settlement + last-Friday options-expiry clocks) on the frozen BTC/ETH/SOL H1 panels.
summary: Both proposals written and committed. Clock rule frozen as 'delivery/expiry instant = 08:00:00 UTC on the LAST FRIDAY of the month (quarterly months Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec for futures delivery)', verified keyless from official exchange contract metadata only (3 URLs, no price data): Binance fapi exchangeInfo CURRENT_QUARTER BTCUSDT_260925 deliveryDate epoch 1790323200000 = 2026-09-25T08:00:00Z and BTCUSDT_261225 = 2026-12-25T08:00:00Z (retrieved_utc 2026-09-11T13:08:44Z); Deribit public get_instruments monthly/quarterly options expiries at last-Friday 08:00 UTC (retrieved_utc 2026-09-11T13:08:55Z); a third retrieval (expired futures metadata) showed venue prunes history, so in-window instants are derived by calendar arithmetic with a fail-closed re-verification requirement on the P2/D2 lane (retrieved_utc 2026-09-11T13:09:56Z). P1 = CNG1-A5-P1 pre-expiry QUARTERLY roll drift: bounded taker-pressure ratio over expiry-morning bars A-8..A-3, entry 06:00 UTC, exit at the 08:00 UTC delivery instant (flat at settlement), 4 events (2025-09-26, 2025-12-26, 2026-03-27, 2026-06-26) x 3 symbols = 12 anchor decisions; neighbour W10 deeper window; sham = Fridays shifted -7d; clock-only long shadow. P2 = CNG1-A5-P2 post-settlement monthly options-expiry unwind fade on NON-quarterly last Fridays: fade of the settlement-hour imbalance bar A, entry 09:00 UTC, exit 21:00 UTC same Friday, 8 events (2025-08-29..2026-07-31) x 3 symbols = 24 anchor decisions; neighbour H4; sham = Fridays shifted +7d; clock-only long shadow. Event sets disjoint from each other and from lane A4's 8 FOMC instants (checked). Full field parity with the A4 template: mechanism with forced-participant identity, warmup, features from panel columns (buy_quote/sell_quote/quote_total/last_price only), Q-8 tier-2.0 cost authority with no stated constants, P-12 representation_identity, WKNDLIQ/OICASCADE/ATTN-PHASE/FUNDJUMP ancestry defense, frozen F1-F5 falsification rules, expected_failure_interpretation.
known_limitations: In-window expiry instants (2025-08-29..2026-07-31) are derived by applying the venue-verified rule via calendar arithmetic; venue metadata endpoints prune expired contracts, so the P2/D2 lane must re-verify each in-window instant fail-closed before any scored use (disclosed in both proposals' spec_verification.verification_limitation).

P1 has only 12 anchor decisions (4 quarterly events/year); recent-6-month estimate is 6 decisions - primary feasibility risk, disclosed; the Q-6 floor is a P2-phase measured gate and may kill P1 for infeasibility before selection.

Holiday-adjacent event dates (2025-11-28 post-Thanksgiving for P2, 2025-12-26 Boxing Day for P1) are the likeliest calendar-conditioned-liquidity leakage path (WKNDLIQ family); the F3 dvol-proxy veto is the designed kill and the hazard is pre-disclosed in both proposals.

Verification URLs were contract-metadata endpoints (no price data); Binance's delivery-time evidence covers current/next quarter contracts only - the 08:00 UTC delivery TIME for the in-window Binance quarterlies is rule-derived, coincident with Deribit expiry epochs which were directly verified at 08:00:00Z.
